انتهكت (form VIII)

# اِنْتَهَكْتَ (intahakta) /in.ta.hak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اِنْتَهَكْتِ (intahakti) /in.ta.hak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اِنْتَهَكَتْ (intahakat) /in.ta.ha.kat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
